semantics_boundary: Directly read complete current name/category/help/extra-help/type/context/source/restart metadata for every PostgreSQL setting. source_query_for_allowlisted_values: SELECT name,setting,unit,source,context,pending_restart FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('fsync','full_page_writes','autovacuum','autovacuum_vacuum_threshold','autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor','autovacuum_analyze_threshold','autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor','log_parameter_max_length','log_parameter_max_length_on_error','log_min_duration_statement','log_lock_waits','log_statement','log_duration','log_connections','log_disconnections','cron.launch_active_jobs','cron.log_statement','cron.enable_superuser_jobs','cron.use_background_workers','lo_compat_privileges','allow_system_table_mods','allow_alter_system','event_triggers','track_activities','track_io_timing','statement_timeout','idle_in_transaction_session_timeout','password_encryption','ssl','ssl_min_protocol_version','row_security','pgaudit.log_parameter','pgaudit.log_rows','pgaudit.log_statement','pg_stat_statements.track','autovacuum_max_workers','zero_damaged_pages','ignore_checksum_failure','ignore_invalid_pages') ORDER BY name

descriptors.name: DateStyle
descriptors.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the display format for date and time values.
descriptors.extra_desc: Also controls interpretation of ambiguous date inputs.

descriptors.name: IntervalStyle
descriptors.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the display format for interval values.

descriptors.name: TimeZone
descriptors.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the time zone for displaying and interpreting time stamps.

descriptors.name: allow_alter_system
descriptors.category: Version and Platform Compatibility / Other Platforms and Clients
descriptors.short_desc: Allows running the ALTER SYSTEM command.
descriptors.extra_desc: Can be set to off for environments where global configuration changes should be made using a different method.

descriptors.name: allow_in_place_tablespaces
descriptors.short_desc: Allows tablespaces directly inside pg_tblspc, for testing.

descriptors.name: allow_system_table_mods
descriptors.short_desc: Allows modifications of the structure of system tables.

descriptors.name: application_name
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the application name to be reported in statistics and logs.

descriptors.name: archive_cleanup_command
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the shell command that will be executed at every restart point.

descriptors.name: archive_command
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the shell command that will be called to archive a WAL file.
descriptors.extra_desc: This is used only if "archive_library" is not set.

descriptors.name: archive_library
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the library that will be called to archive a WAL file.
descriptors.extra_desc: An empty string indicates that "archive_command" should be used.

descriptors.name: archive_mode
descriptors.short_desc: Allows archiving of WAL files using "archive_command".

descriptors.name: archive_timeout
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the amount of time to wait before forcing a switch to the next WAL file.

descriptors.name: array_nulls
descriptors.category: Version and Platform Compatibility / Previous PostgreSQL Versions
descriptors.short_desc: Enable input of NULL elements in arrays.
descriptors.extra_desc: When turned on, unquoted NULL in an array input value means a null value; otherwise it is taken literally.

descriptors.name: authentication_timeout
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed time to complete client authentication.

descriptors.name: auto_explain.log_analyze
descriptors.short_desc: Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE for plan logging.

descriptors.name: auto_explain.log_buffers
descriptors.short_desc: Log buffers usage.

descriptors.name: auto_explain.log_format
descriptors.short_desc: EXPLAIN format to be used for plan logging.

descriptors.name: auto_explain.log_level
descriptors.short_desc: Log level for the plan.

descriptors.name: auto_explain.log_min_duration
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the minimum execution time above which plans will be logged.
descriptors.extra_desc: Zero prints all plans. -1 turns this feature off.

descriptors.name: auto_explain.log_nested_statements
descriptors.short_desc: Log nested statements.

descriptors.name: auto_explain.log_parameter_max_length
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum length of query parameters to log.
descriptors.extra_desc: Zero logs no query parameters, -1 logs them in full.

descriptors.name: auto_explain.log_settings
descriptors.short_desc: Log modified configuration parameters affecting query planning.

descriptors.name: auto_explain.log_timing
descriptors.short_desc: Collect timing data, not just row counts.

descriptors.name: auto_explain.log_triggers
descriptors.short_desc: Include trigger statistics in plans.
descriptors.extra_desc: This has no effect unless log_analyze is also set.

descriptors.name: auto_explain.log_verbose
descriptors.short_desc: Use EXPLAIN VERBOSE for plan logging.

descriptors.name: auto_explain.log_wal
descriptors.short_desc: Log WAL usage.

descriptors.name: auto_explain.sample_rate
descriptors.short_desc: Fraction of queries to process.

descriptors.name: autovacuum
descriptors.short_desc: Starts the autovacuum subprocess.

descriptors.name: autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor
descriptors.short_desc: Number of tuple inserts, updates, or deletes prior to analyze as a fraction of reltuples.

descriptors.name: autovacuum_analyze_threshold
descriptors.short_desc: Minimum number of tuple inserts, updates, or deletes prior to analyze.

descriptors.name: autovacuum_freeze_max_age
descriptors.short_desc: Age at which to autovacuum a table to prevent transaction ID wraparound.

descriptors.name: autovacuum_max_workers
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously running autovacuum worker processes.

descriptors.name: autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age
descriptors.short_desc: Multixact age at which to autovacuum a table to prevent multixact wraparound.

descriptors.name: autovacuum_naptime
descriptors.short_desc: Time to sleep between autovacuum runs.

descriptors.name: autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay
descriptors.short_desc: Vacuum cost delay in milliseconds, for autovacuum.

descriptors.name: autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit
descriptors.short_desc: Vacuum cost amount available before napping, for autovacuum.

descriptors.name: autovacuum_vacuum_insert_scale_factor
descriptors.short_desc: Number of tuple inserts prior to vacuum as a fraction of reltuples.

descriptors.name: autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold
descriptors.short_desc: Minimum number of tuple inserts prior to vacuum, or -1 to disable insert vacuums.

descriptors.name: autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor
descriptors.short_desc: Number of tuple updates or deletes prior to vacuum as a fraction of reltuples.

descriptors.name: autovacuum_vacuum_threshold
descriptors.short_desc: Minimum number of tuple updates or deletes prior to vacuum.

descriptors.name: autovacuum_work_mem
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum memory to be used by each autovacuum worker process.

descriptors.name: backend_flush_after
descriptors.short_desc: Number of pages after which previously performed writes are flushed to disk.

descriptors.name: backslash_quote
descriptors.category: Version and Platform Compatibility / Previous PostgreSQL Versions
descriptors.short_desc: Sets whether "\'" is allowed in string literals.

descriptors.name: backtrace_functions
descriptors.short_desc: Log backtrace for errors in these functions.

descriptors.name: bgwriter_delay
descriptors.short_desc: Background writer sleep time between rounds.

descriptors.name: bgwriter_flush_after
descriptors.short_desc: Number of pages after which previously performed writes are flushed to disk.

descriptors.name: bgwriter_lru_maxpages
descriptors.short_desc: Background writer maximum number of LRU pages to flush per round.

descriptors.name: bgwriter_lru_multiplier
descriptors.short_desc: Multiple of the average buffer usage to free per round.

descriptors.name: block_size
descriptors.short_desc: Shows the size of a disk block.

descriptors.name: bonjour
descriptors.short_desc: Enables advertising the server via Bonjour.

descriptors.name: bonjour_name
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the Bonjour service name.

descriptors.name: bytea_output
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the output format for bytea.

descriptors.name: check_function_bodies
descriptors.short_desc: Check routine bodies during CREATE FUNCTION and CREATE PROCEDURE.

descriptors.name: checkpoint_completion_target
descriptors.short_desc: Time spent flushing dirty buffers during checkpoint, as fraction of checkpoint interval.

descriptors.name: checkpoint_flush_after
descriptors.short_desc: Number of pages after which previously performed writes are flushed to disk.

descriptors.name: checkpoint_timeout
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum time between automatic WAL checkpoints.

descriptors.name: checkpoint_warning
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum time before warning if checkpoints triggered by WAL volume happen too frequently.
descriptors.extra_desc: Write a message to the server log if checkpoints caused by the filling of WAL segment files happen more frequently than this amount of time. Zero turns off the warning.

descriptors.name: client_connection_check_interval
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the time interval between checks for disconnection while running queries.

descriptors.name: client_encoding
descriptors.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the client's character set encoding.

descriptors.name: client_min_messages
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the message levels that are sent to the client.
descriptors.extra_desc: Each level includes all the levels that follow it. The later the level, the fewer messages are sent.

descriptors.name: cluster_name
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the name of the cluster, which is included in the process title.

descriptors.name: commit_delay
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the delay in microseconds between transaction commit and flushing WAL to disk.

descriptors.name: commit_siblings
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the minimum number of concurrent open transactions required before performing "commit_delay".

descriptors.name: commit_timestamp_buffers
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the size of the dedicated buffer pool used for the commit timestamp cache.
descriptors.extra_desc: Specify 0 to have this value determined as a fraction of shared_buffers.

descriptors.name: compute_query_id
descriptors.short_desc: Enables in-core computation of query identifiers.

descriptors.name: config_file
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the server's main configuration file.

descriptors.name: constraint_exclusion
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner to use constraints to optimize queries.
descriptors.extra_desc: Table scans will be skipped if their constraints guarantee that no rows match the query.

descriptors.name: cpu_index_tuple_cost
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of processing each index entry during an index scan.

descriptors.name: cpu_operator_cost
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of processing each operator or function call.

descriptors.name: cpu_tuple_cost
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of processing each tuple (row).

descriptors.name: createrole_self_grant
descriptors.short_desc: Sets whether a CREATEROLE user automatically grants the role to themselves, and with which options.

descriptors.name: cron.database_name
descriptors.short_desc: Database in which pg_cron metadata is kept.

descriptors.name: cron.enable_superuser_jobs
descriptors.short_desc: Allow jobs to be scheduled as superuser

descriptors.name: cron.host
descriptors.short_desc: Hostname to connect to postgres.
descriptors.extra_desc: This setting has no effect when background workers are used.

descriptors.name: cron.launch_active_jobs
descriptors.short_desc: Launch jobs that are defined as active.

descriptors.name: cron.log_min_messages
descriptors.short_desc: log_min_messages for the launcher bgworker.

descriptors.name: cron.log_run
descriptors.short_desc: Log all jobs runs into the job_run_details table

descriptors.name: cron.log_statement
descriptors.short_desc: Log all cron statements prior to execution.

descriptors.name: cron.max_running_jobs
descriptors.short_desc: Maximum number of jobs that can run concurrently.

descriptors.name: cron.timezone
descriptors.short_desc: Specify timezone used for cron schedule.

descriptors.name: cron.use_background_workers
descriptors.short_desc: Use background workers instead of client sessions.

descriptors.name: cursor_tuple_fraction
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the fraction of a cursor's rows that will be retrieved.

descriptors.name: data_checksums
descriptors.short_desc: Shows whether data checksums are turned on for this cluster.

descriptors.name: data_directory
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the server's data directory.

descriptors.name: data_directory_mode
descriptors.short_desc: Shows the mode of the data directory.
descriptors.extra_desc: The parameter value is a numeric mode specification in the form accepted by the chmod and umask system calls. (To use the customary octal format the number must start with a 0 (zero).)

descriptors.name: data_sync_retry
descriptors.short_desc: Whether to continue running after a failure to sync data files.

descriptors.name: deadlock_timeout
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the time to wait on a lock before checking for deadlock.

descriptors.name: debug_assertions
descriptors.short_desc: Shows whether the running server has assertion checks enabled.

descriptors.name: debug_discard_caches
descriptors.short_desc: Aggressively flush system caches for debugging purposes.

descriptors.name: debug_io_direct
descriptors.short_desc: Use direct I/O for file access.

descriptors.name: debug_logical_replication_streaming
descriptors.short_desc: Forces immediate streaming or serialization of changes in large transactions.
descriptors.extra_desc: On the publisher, it allows streaming or serializing each change in logical decoding. On the subscriber, it allows serialization of all changes to files and notifies the parallel apply workers to read and apply them at the end of the transaction.

descriptors.name: debug_parallel_query
descriptors.short_desc: Forces the planner's use parallel query nodes.
descriptors.extra_desc: This can be useful for testing the parallel query infrastructure by forcing the planner to generate plans that contain nodes that perform tuple communication between workers and the main process.

descriptors.name: debug_pretty_print
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Indents parse and plan tree displays.

descriptors.name: debug_print_parse
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Logs each query's parse tree.

descriptors.name: debug_print_plan
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Logs each query's execution plan.

descriptors.name: debug_print_rewritten
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Logs each query's rewritten parse tree.

descriptors.name: default_statistics_target
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the default statistics target.
descriptors.extra_desc: This applies to table columns that have not had a column-specific target set via ALTER TABLE SET STATISTICS.

descriptors.name: default_table_access_method
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the default table access method for new tables.

descriptors.name: default_tablespace
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the default tablespace to create tables and indexes in.
descriptors.extra_desc: An empty string selects the database's default tablespace.

descriptors.name: default_text_search_config
descriptors.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
descriptors.short_desc: Sets default text search configuration.

descriptors.name: default_toast_compression
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the default compression method for compressible values.

descriptors.name: default_transaction_deferrable
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the default deferrable status of new transactions.

descriptors.name: default_transaction_isolation
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the transaction isolation level of each new transaction.

descriptors.name: default_transaction_read_only
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the default read-only status of new transactions.

descriptors.name: dynamic_library_path
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the path for dynamically loadable modules.
descriptors.extra_desc: If a dynamically loadable module needs to be opened and the specified name does not have a directory component (i.e., the name does not contain a slash), the system will search this path for the specified file.

descriptors.name: dynamic_shared_memory_type
descriptors.short_desc: Selects the dynamic shared memory implementation used.

descriptors.name: effective_cache_size
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the planner's assumption about the total size of the data caches.
descriptors.extra_desc: That is, the total size of the caches (kernel cache and shared buffers) used for PostgreSQL data files. This is measured in disk pages, which are normally 8 kB each.

descriptors.name: effective_io_concurrency
descriptors.short_desc: Number of simultaneous requests that can be handled efficiently by the disk subsystem.

descriptors.name: enable_async_append
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of async append plans.

descriptors.name: enable_bitmapscan
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of bitmap-scan plans.

descriptors.name: enable_gathermerge
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of gather merge plans.

descriptors.name: enable_group_by_reordering
descriptors.short_desc: Enables reordering of GROUP BY keys.

descriptors.name: enable_hashagg
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of hashed aggregation plans.

descriptors.name: enable_hashjoin
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of hash join plans.

descriptors.name: enable_incremental_sort
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of incremental sort steps.

descriptors.name: enable_indexonlyscan
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of index-only-scan plans.

descriptors.name: enable_indexscan
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of index-scan plans.

descriptors.name: enable_material
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of materialization.

descriptors.name: enable_memoize
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of memoization.

descriptors.name: enable_mergejoin
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of merge join plans.

descriptors.name: enable_nestloop
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of nested-loop join plans.

descriptors.name: enable_parallel_append
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of parallel append plans.

descriptors.name: enable_parallel_hash
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of parallel hash plans.

descriptors.name: enable_partition_pruning
descriptors.short_desc: Enables plan-time and execution-time partition pruning.
descriptors.extra_desc: Allows the query planner and executor to compare partition bounds to conditions in the query to determine which partitions must be scanned.

descriptors.name: enable_partitionwise_aggregate
descriptors.short_desc: Enables partitionwise aggregation and grouping.

descriptors.name: enable_partitionwise_join
descriptors.short_desc: Enables partitionwise join.

descriptors.name: enable_presorted_aggregate
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's ability to produce plans that provide presorted input for ORDER BY / DISTINCT aggregate functions.
descriptors.extra_desc: Allows the query planner to build plans that provide presorted input for aggregate functions with an ORDER BY / DISTINCT clause.  When disabled, implicit sorts are always performed during execution.

descriptors.name: enable_seqscan
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of sequential-scan plans.

descriptors.name: enable_sort
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of explicit sort steps.

descriptors.name: enable_tidscan
descriptors.short_desc: Enables the planner's use of TID scan plans.

descriptors.name: escape_string_warning
descriptors.category: Version and Platform Compatibility / Previous PostgreSQL Versions
descriptors.short_desc: Warn about backslash escapes in ordinary string literals.

descriptors.name: event_source
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the application name used to identify PostgreSQL messages in the event log.

descriptors.name: event_triggers
descriptors.short_desc: Enables event triggers.
descriptors.extra_desc: When enabled, event triggers will fire for all applicable statements.

descriptors.name: exit_on_error
descriptors.short_desc: Terminate session on any error.

descriptors.name: external_pid_file
descriptors.short_desc: Writes the postmaster PID to the specified file.

descriptors.name: extra_float_digits
descriptors.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the number of digits displayed for floating-point values.
descriptors.extra_desc: This affects real, double precision, and geometric data types. A zero or negative parameter value is added to the standard number of digits (FLT_DIG or DBL_DIG as appropriate). Any value greater than zero selects precise output mode.

descriptors.name: file_extend_method
descriptors.short_desc: Selects the method used for extending data files.

descriptors.name: from_collapse_limit
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the FROM-list size beyond which subqueries are not collapsed.
descriptors.extra_desc: The planner will merge subqueries into upper queries if the resulting FROM list would have no more than this many items.

descriptors.name: fsync
descriptors.short_desc: Forces synchronization of updates to disk.
descriptors.extra_desc: The server will use the fsync() system call in several places to make sure that updates are physically written to disk. This ensures that a database cluster will recover to a consistent state after an operating system or hardware crash.

descriptors.name: full_page_writes
descriptors.short_desc: Writes full pages to WAL when first modified after a checkpoint.
descriptors.extra_desc: A page write in process during an operating system crash might be only partially written to disk.  During recovery, the row changes stored in WAL are not enough to recover.  This option writes pages when first modified after a checkpoint to WAL so full recovery is possible.

descriptors.name: geqo
descriptors.short_desc: Enables genetic query optimization.
descriptors.extra_desc: This algorithm attempts to do planning without exhaustive searching.

descriptors.name: geqo_effort
descriptors.short_desc: GEQO: effort is used to set the default for other GEQO parameters.

descriptors.name: geqo_generations
descriptors.short_desc: GEQO: number of iterations of the algorithm.
descriptors.extra_desc: Zero selects a suitable default value.

descriptors.name: geqo_pool_size
descriptors.short_desc: GEQO: number of individuals in the population.
descriptors.extra_desc: Zero selects a suitable default value.

descriptors.name: geqo_seed
descriptors.short_desc: GEQO: seed for random path selection.

descriptors.name: geqo_selection_bias
descriptors.short_desc: GEQO: selective pressure within the population.

descriptors.name: geqo_threshold
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the threshold of FROM items beyond which GEQO is used.

descriptors.name: gin_fuzzy_search_limit
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed result for exact search by GIN.

descriptors.name: gin_pending_list_limit
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum size of the pending list for GIN index.

descriptors.name: gss_accept_delegation
descriptors.short_desc: Sets whether GSSAPI delegation should be accepted from the client.

descriptors.name: hash_mem_multiplier
descriptors.short_desc: Multiple of "work_mem" to use for hash tables.

descriptors.name: hba_file
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the server's "hba" configuration file.

descriptors.name: hot_standby
descriptors.short_desc: Allows connections and queries during recovery.

descriptors.name: hot_standby_feedback
descriptors.short_desc: Allows feedback from a hot standby to the primary that will avoid query conflicts.

descriptors.name: huge_page_size
descriptors.short_desc: The size of huge page that should be requested.

descriptors.name: huge_pages
descriptors.short_desc: Use of huge pages on Linux or Windows.

descriptors.name: huge_pages_status
descriptors.short_desc: Indicates the status of huge pages.

descriptors.name: icu_validation_level
descriptors.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
descriptors.short_desc: Log level for reporting invalid ICU locale strings.

descriptors.name: ident_file
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the server's "ident" configuration file.

descriptors.name: idle_in_transaction_session_timeout
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed idle time between queries, when in a transaction.
descriptors.extra_desc: A value of 0 turns off the timeout.

descriptors.name: idle_session_timeout
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed idle time between queries, when not in a transaction.
descriptors.extra_desc: A value of 0 turns off the timeout.

descriptors.name: ignore_checksum_failure
descriptors.short_desc: Continues processing after a checksum failure.
descriptors.extra_desc: Detection of a checksum failure normally causes PostgreSQL to report an error, aborting the current transaction. Setting ignore_checksum_failure to true causes the system to ignore the failure (but still report a warning), and continue processing. This behavior could cause crashes or other serious problems. Only has an effect if checksums are enabled.

descriptors.name: ignore_invalid_pages
descriptors.short_desc: Continues recovery after an invalid pages failure.
descriptors.extra_desc: Detection of WAL records having references to invalid pages during recovery causes PostgreSQL to raise a PANIC-level error, aborting the recovery. Setting "ignore_invalid_pages" to true causes the system to ignore invalid page references in WAL records (but still report a warning), and continue recovery. This behavior may cause crashes, data loss, propagate or hide corruption, or other serious problems. Only has an effect during recovery or in standby mode.

descriptors.name: ignore_system_indexes
descriptors.short_desc: Disables reading from system indexes.
descriptors.extra_desc: It does not prevent updating the indexes, so it is safe to use.  The worst consequence is slowness.

descriptors.name: in_hot_standby
descriptors.short_desc: Shows whether hot standby is currently active.

descriptors.name: integer_datetimes
descriptors.short_desc: Shows whether datetimes are integer based.

descriptors.name: io_combine_limit
descriptors.short_desc: Limit on the size of data reads and writes.

descriptors.name: jit
descriptors.short_desc: Allow JIT compilation.

descriptors.name: jit_above_cost
descriptors.short_desc: Perform JIT compilation if query is more expensive.
descriptors.extra_desc: -1 disables JIT compilation.

descriptors.name: jit_debugging_support
descriptors.short_desc: Register JIT-compiled functions with debugger.

descriptors.name: jit_dump_bitcode
descriptors.short_desc: Write out LLVM bitcode to facilitate JIT debugging.

descriptors.name: jit_expressions
descriptors.short_desc: Allow JIT compilation of expressions.

descriptors.name: jit_inline_above_cost
descriptors.short_desc: Perform JIT inlining if query is more expensive.
descriptors.extra_desc: -1 disables inlining.

descriptors.name: jit_optimize_above_cost
descriptors.short_desc: Optimize JIT-compiled functions if query is more expensive.
descriptors.extra_desc: -1 disables optimization.

descriptors.name: jit_profiling_support
descriptors.short_desc: Register JIT-compiled functions with perf profiler.

descriptors.name: jit_provider
descriptors.category: Client Connection Defaults / Shared Library Preloading
descriptors.short_desc: JIT provider to use.

descriptors.name: jit_tuple_deforming
descriptors.short_desc: Allow JIT compilation of tuple deforming.

descriptors.name: join_collapse_limit
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the FROM-list size beyond which JOIN constructs are not flattened.
descriptors.extra_desc: The planner will flatten explicit JOIN constructs into lists of FROM items whenever a list of no more than this many items would result.

descriptors.name: krb_caseins_users
descriptors.short_desc: Sets whether Kerberos and GSSAPI user names should be treated as case-insensitive.

descriptors.name: krb_server_keyfile
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the location of the Kerberos server key file.

descriptors.name: lc_messages
descriptors.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the language in which messages are displayed.

descriptors.name: lc_monetary
descriptors.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the locale for formatting monetary amounts.

descriptors.name: lc_numeric
descriptors.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the locale for formatting numbers.

descriptors.name: lc_time
descriptors.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the locale for formatting date and time values.

descriptors.name: listen_addresses
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the host name or IP address(es) to listen to.

descriptors.name: lo_compat_privileges
descriptors.category: Version and Platform Compatibility / Previous PostgreSQL Versions
descriptors.short_desc: Enables backward compatibility mode for privilege checks on large objects.
descriptors.extra_desc: Skips privilege checks when reading or modifying large objects, for compatibility with PostgreSQL releases prior to 9.0.

descriptors.name: local_preload_libraries
descriptors.category: Client Connection Defaults / Shared Library Preloading
descriptors.short_desc: Lists unprivileged shared libraries to preload into each backend.

descriptors.name: lock_timeout
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed duration of any wait for a lock.
descriptors.extra_desc: A value of 0 turns off the timeout.

descriptors.name: log_autovacuum_min_duration
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the minimum execution time above which autovacuum actions will be logged.
descriptors.extra_desc: Zero prints all actions. -1 turns autovacuum logging off.

descriptors.name: log_checkpoints
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Logs each checkpoint.

descriptors.name: log_connections
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Logs each successful connection.

descriptors.name: log_destination
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the destination for server log output.
descriptors.extra_desc: Valid values are combinations of "stderr", "syslog", "csvlog", "jsonlog", and "eventlog", depending on the platform.

descriptors.name: log_directory
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the destination directory for log files.
descriptors.extra_desc: Can be specified as relative to the data directory or as absolute path.

descriptors.name: log_disconnections
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Logs end of a session, including duration.

descriptors.name: log_duration
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Logs the duration of each completed SQL statement.

descriptors.name: log_error_verbosity
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the verbosity of logged messages.

descriptors.name: log_executor_stats
descriptors.short_desc: Writes executor performance statistics to the server log.

descriptors.name: log_file_mode
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the file permissions for log files.
descriptors.extra_desc: The parameter value is expected to be a numeric mode specification in the form accepted by the chmod and umask system calls. (To use the customary octal format the number must start with a 0 (zero).)

descriptors.name: log_filename
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the file name pattern for log files.

descriptors.name: log_hostname
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Logs the host name in the connection logs.
descriptors.extra_desc: By default, connection logs only show the IP address of the connecting host. If you want them to show the host name you can turn this on, but depending on your host name resolution setup it might impose a non-negligible performance penalty.

descriptors.name: log_line_prefix
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Controls information prefixed to each log line.
descriptors.extra_desc: If blank, no prefix is used.

descriptors.name: log_lock_waits
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Logs long lock waits.

descriptors.name: log_min_duration_sample
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / When to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the minimum execution time above which a sample of statements will be logged. Sampling is determined by log_statement_sample_rate.
descriptors.extra_desc: Zero logs a sample of all queries. -1 turns this feature off.

descriptors.name: log_min_duration_statement
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / When to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the minimum execution time above which all statements will be logged.
descriptors.extra_desc: Zero prints all queries. -1 turns this feature off.

descriptors.name: log_min_error_statement
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / When to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Causes all statements generating error at or above this level to be logged.
descriptors.extra_desc: Each level includes all the levels that follow it. The later the level, the fewer messages are sent.

descriptors.name: log_min_messages
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / When to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the message levels that are logged.
descriptors.extra_desc: Each level includes all the levels that follow it. The later the level, the fewer messages are sent.

descriptors.name: log_parameter_max_length
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum length in bytes of data logged for bind parameter values when logging statements.
descriptors.extra_desc: -1 to print values in full.

descriptors.name: log_parameter_max_length_on_error
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum length in bytes of data logged for bind parameter values when logging statements, on error.
descriptors.extra_desc: -1 to print values in full.

descriptors.name: log_parser_stats
descriptors.short_desc: Writes parser performance statistics to the server log.

descriptors.name: log_planner_stats
descriptors.short_desc: Writes planner performance statistics to the server log.

descriptors.name: log_recovery_conflict_waits
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Logs standby recovery conflict waits.

descriptors.name: log_replication_commands
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Logs each replication command.

descriptors.name: log_rotation_age
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the amount of time to wait before forcing log file rotation.

descriptors.name: log_rotation_size
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum size a log file can reach before being rotated.

descriptors.name: log_startup_progress_interval
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / When to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Time between progress updates for long-running startup operations.
descriptors.extra_desc: 0 turns this feature off.

descriptors.name: log_statement
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the type of statements logged.

descriptors.name: log_statement_sample_rate
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / When to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Fraction of statements exceeding "log_min_duration_sample" to be logged.
descriptors.extra_desc: Use a value between 0.0 (never log) and 1.0 (always log).

descriptors.name: log_statement_stats
descriptors.short_desc: Writes cumulative performance statistics to the server log.

descriptors.name: log_temp_files
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Log the use of temporary files larger than this number of kilobytes.
descriptors.extra_desc: Zero logs all files. The default is -1 (turning this feature off).

descriptors.name: log_timezone
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the time zone to use in log messages.

descriptors.name: log_transaction_sample_rate
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / When to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the fraction of transactions from which to log all statements.
descriptors.extra_desc: Use a value between 0.0 (never log) and 1.0 (log all statements for all transactions).

descriptors.name: log_truncate_on_rotation
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Truncate existing log files of same name during log rotation.

descriptors.name: logging_collector
descriptors.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log
descriptors.short_desc: Start a subprocess to capture stderr, csvlog and/or jsonlog into log files.

descriptors.name: logical_decoding_work_mem
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum memory to be used for logical decoding.
descriptors.extra_desc: This much memory can be used by each internal reorder buffer before spilling to disk.

descriptors.name: maintenance_io_concurrency
descriptors.short_desc: A variant of "effective_io_concurrency" that is used for maintenance work.

descriptors.name: maintenance_work_mem
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum memory to be used for maintenance operations.
descriptors.extra_desc: This includes operations such as VACUUM and CREATE INDEX.

descriptors.name: max_connections
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of concurrent connections.

descriptors.name: max_files_per_process
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously open files for each server process.

descriptors.name: max_function_args
descriptors.short_desc: Shows the maximum number of function arguments.

descriptors.name: max_identifier_length
descriptors.short_desc: Shows the maximum identifier length.

descriptors.name: max_index_keys
descriptors.short_desc: Shows the maximum number of index keys.

descriptors.name: max_locks_per_transaction
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of locks per transaction.
descriptors.extra_desc: The shared lock table is sized on the assumption that at most "max_locks_per_transaction" objects per server process or prepared transaction will need to be locked at any one time.

descriptors.name: max_logical_replication_workers
descriptors.short_desc: Maximum number of logical replication worker processes.

descriptors.name: max_notify_queue_pages
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of allocated pages for NOTIFY / LISTEN queue.

descriptors.name: max_parallel_apply_workers_per_subscription
descriptors.short_desc: Maximum number of parallel apply workers per subscription.

descriptors.name: max_parallel_maintenance_workers
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of parallel processes per maintenance operation.

descriptors.name: max_parallel_workers
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of parallel workers that can be active at one time.

descriptors.name: max_parallel_workers_per_gather
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of parallel processes per executor node.

descriptors.name: max_pred_locks_per_page
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of predicate-locked tuples per page.
descriptors.extra_desc: If more than this number of tuples on the same page are locked by a connection, those locks are replaced by a page-level lock.

descriptors.name: max_pred_locks_per_relation
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of predicate-locked pages and tuples per relation.
descriptors.extra_desc: If more than this total of pages and tuples in the same relation are locked by a connection, those locks are replaced by a relation-level lock.

descriptors.name: max_pred_locks_per_transaction
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of predicate locks per transaction.
descriptors.extra_desc: The shared predicate lock table is sized on the assumption that at most "max_pred_locks_per_transaction" objects per server process or prepared transaction will need to be locked at any one time.

descriptors.name: max_prepared_transactions
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously prepared transactions.

descriptors.name: max_replication_slots
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously defined replication slots.

descriptors.name: max_slot_wal_keep_size
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum WAL size that can be reserved by replication slots.
descriptors.extra_desc: Replication slots will be marked as failed, and segments released for deletion or recycling, if this much space is occupied by WAL on disk.

descriptors.name: max_stack_depth
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum stack depth, in kilobytes.

descriptors.name: max_standby_archive_delay
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum delay before canceling queries when a hot standby server is processing archived WAL data.

descriptors.name: max_standby_streaming_delay
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum delay before canceling queries when a hot standby server is processing streamed WAL data.

descriptors.name: max_sync_workers_per_subscription
descriptors.short_desc: Maximum number of table synchronization workers per subscription.

descriptors.name: max_wal_senders
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously running WAL sender processes.

descriptors.name: max_wal_size
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the WAL size that triggers a checkpoint.

descriptors.name: max_worker_processes
descriptors.short_desc: Maximum number of concurrent worker processes.

descriptors.name: min_dynamic_shared_memory
descriptors.short_desc: Amount of dynamic shared memory reserved at startup.

descriptors.name: min_parallel_index_scan_size
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the minimum amount of index data for a parallel scan.
descriptors.extra_desc: If the planner estimates that it will read a number of index pages too small to reach this limit, a parallel scan will not be considered.

descriptors.name: min_parallel_table_scan_size
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the minimum amount of table data for a parallel scan.
descriptors.extra_desc: If the planner estimates that it will read a number of table pages too small to reach this limit, a parallel scan will not be considered.

descriptors.name: min_wal_size
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the minimum size to shrink the WAL to.

descriptors.name: multixact_member_buffers
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the size of the dedicated buffer pool used for the MultiXact member cache.

descriptors.name: multixact_offset_buffers
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the size of the dedicated buffer pool used for the MultiXact offset cache.

descriptors.name: notify_buffers
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the size of the dedicated buffer pool used for the LISTEN/NOTIFY message cache.

descriptors.name: output_plugin_libraries
descriptors.short_desc: Lists libraries that may be named as logical decoding output plugins.
descriptors.extra_desc: Users with REPLICATION privileges may only use plugins in this list when creating logical replication slots.

descriptors.name: parallel_leader_participation
descriptors.short_desc: Controls whether Gather and Gather Merge also run subplans.
descriptors.extra_desc: Should gather nodes also run subplans or just gather tuples?

descriptors.name: parallel_setup_cost
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of starting up worker processes for parallel query.

descriptors.name: parallel_tuple_cost
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of passing each tuple (row) from worker to leader backend.

descriptors.name: password_encryption
descriptors.short_desc: Chooses the algorithm for encrypting passwords.

descriptors.name: pg_net.batch_size
descriptors.short_desc: number of requests executed in one iteration of the background worker

descriptors.name: pg_net.database_name
descriptors.short_desc: Database where the worker will connect to

descriptors.name: pg_net.ttl
descriptors.short_desc: time to live for request/response rows
descriptors.extra_desc: should be a valid interval type

descriptors.name: pg_net.username
descriptors.short_desc: Connection user for the worker

descriptors.name: pg_stat_statements.max
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of statements tracked by pg_stat_statements.

descriptors.name: pg_stat_statements.save
descriptors.short_desc: Save pg_stat_statements statistics across server shutdowns.

descriptors.name: pg_stat_statements.track
descriptors.short_desc: Selects which statements are tracked by pg_stat_statements.

descriptors.name: pg_stat_statements.track_planning
descriptors.short_desc: Selects whether planning duration is tracked by pg_stat_statements.

descriptors.name: pg_stat_statements.track_utility
descriptors.short_desc: Selects whether utility commands are tracked by pg_stat_statements.

descriptors.name: pgaudit.log
descriptors.short_desc: Specifies which classes of statements will be logged by session audit logging. Multiple classes can be provided using a comma-separated list and classes can be subtracted by prefacing the class with a - sign.

descriptors.name: pgaudit.log_catalog
descriptors.short_desc: Specifies that session logging should be enabled in the case where all relations in a statement are in pg_catalog.  Disabling this setting will reduce noise in the log from tools like psql and PgAdmin that query the catalog heavily.

descriptors.name: pgaudit.log_client
descriptors.short_desc: Specifies whether audit messages should be visible to the client. This setting should generally be left disabled but may be useful for debugging or other purposes.

descriptors.name: pgaudit.log_level
descriptors.short_desc: Specifies the log level that will be used for log entries. This setting is used for regression testing and may also be useful to end users for testing or other purposes.  It is not intended to be used in a production environment as it may leak which statements are being logged to the user.

descriptors.name: pgaudit.log_parameter
descriptors.short_desc: Specifies that audit logging should include the parameters that were passed with the statement. When parameters are present they will be be included in CSV format after the statement text.

descriptors.name: pgaudit.log_parameter_max_size
descriptors.short_desc: Specifies, in bytes, the maximum length of variable-length parameters to log.  If 0 (the default), parameters are not checked for size.  If set, when the size of the parameter is longer than the setting, the value in the audit log is replaced with a placeholder. Note that for character types, the length is in bytes for the parameter's encoding, not characters.

descriptors.name: pgaudit.log_relation
descriptors.short_desc: Specifies whether session audit logging should create a separate log entry for each relation referenced in a SELECT or DML statement. This is a useful shortcut for exhaustive logging without using object audit logging.

descriptors.name: pgaudit.log_rows
descriptors.short_desc: Specifies whether logging will include the rows retrieved or affected by a statement.

descriptors.name: pgaudit.log_statement
descriptors.short_desc: Specifies whether logging will include the statement text and parameters.  Depending on requirements, the full statement text might not be required in the audit log.

descriptors.name: pgaudit.log_statement_once
descriptors.short_desc: Specifies whether logging will include the statement text and parameters with the first log entry for a statement/substatement combination or with every entry.  Enabling this setting will result in less verbose logging but may make it more difficult to determine the statement that generated a log entry, though the statement/substatement pair along with the process id should suffice to identify the statement text logged with a previous entry.

descriptors.name: pgaudit.role
descriptors.short_desc: Specifies the master role to use for object audit logging.  Multiple audit roles can be defined by granting them to the master role. This allows multiple groups to be in charge of different aspects of audit logging.

descriptors.name: pgsodium.getkey_script
descriptors.short_desc: path to script that returns pgsodium root key

descriptors.name: pgtle.clientauth_databases_to_skip
descriptors.short_desc: Comma-delimited list of databases that pg_tle clientauth hook skips.

descriptors.name: pgtle.clientauth_db_name
descriptors.short_desc: Database in which pg_tle clientauth hook executes.

descriptors.name: pgtle.clientauth_num_parallel_workers
descriptors.short_desc: Number of parallel background workers used by clientauth feature.

descriptors.name: pgtle.clientauth_users_to_skip
descriptors.short_desc: Comma-delimited list of users that pg_tle clientauth hook skips.

descriptors.name: pgtle.enable_clientauth
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the behavior for interacting with the pg_tle clientauth feature.

descriptors.name: pgtle.enable_password_check
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the behavior for interacting with passcheck feature.

descriptors.name: pgtle.passcheck_db_name
descriptors.short_desc: Database containing pg_tle passcheck hook functions.

descriptors.name: plan_cache_mode
descriptors.short_desc: Controls the planner's selection of custom or generic plan.
descriptors.extra_desc: Prepared statements can have custom and generic plans, and the planner will attempt to choose which is better.  This can be set to override the default behavior.

descriptors.name: plan_filter.filter_select_only
descriptors.short_desc: Limit the filter to SELECT queries only.
descriptors.extra_desc: true turns this feature on (Default is false).

descriptors.name: plan_filter.module_loaded
descriptors.short_desc: true if the module is loaded

descriptors.name: plan_filter.statement_cost_limit
descriptors.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed plan cost above which a statement will not run.
descriptors.extra_desc: Zero turns this feature off.

descriptors.name: plpgsql.check_asserts
descriptors.short_desc: Perform checks given in ASSERT statements.

descriptors.name: plpgsql.extra_errors
descriptors.short_desc: List of programming constructs that should produce an error.

descriptors.name: plpgsql.extra_warnings
descriptors.short_desc: List of programming constructs that should produce a warning.

descriptors.name: plpgsql.print_strict_params
descriptors.short_desc: Print information about parameters in the DETAIL part of the error messages generated on INTO ... STRICT failures.

descriptors.name: plpgsql.variable_conflict
descriptors.short_desc: Sets handling of conflicts between PL/pgSQL variable names and table column names.

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.compatibility_warnings
descriptors.short_desc: when is true, then compatibility warnings are showed

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.constants_tracing
descriptors.short_desc: when is true, the variables with constant value can be used like constant

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.cursors_leaks
descriptors.short_desc: when is true, then detection of unclosed cursors is active

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.cursors_leaks_errlevel
descriptors.short_desc: sets an error level of detection of unclosed cursors

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.enable_tracer
descriptors.short_desc: when is true, then tracer's functionality is enabled

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.fatal_errors
descriptors.short_desc: when is true, then plpgsql check stops execution on detected error

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.mode
descriptors.short_desc: choose a mode for enhanced checking

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.profiler
descriptors.short_desc: when is true, then function execution profile is updated

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.profiler_max_shared_chunks
descriptors.short_desc: maximum numbers of statements chunks in shared memory

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.regress_test_mode
descriptors.short_desc: reduces volatile output

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.show_nonperformance_extra_warnings
descriptors.short_desc: when is true, then extra warning (except performance warnings) are showed

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.show_nonperformance_warnings
descriptors.short_desc: when is true, then warning (except performance warnings) are showed

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.show_performance_warnings
descriptors.short_desc: when is true, then performance warnings are showed

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.strict_cursors_leaks
descriptors.short_desc: when is true, then detection of unclosed cursors is executed immediately when function is finished

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.trace_assert
descriptors.short_desc: when is true, then statement ASSERT is traced

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.trace_assert_verbosity
descriptors.short_desc: sets the verbosity of trace ASSERT statement

descriptors.name: plpgsql_check.tracer
descriptors.short_desc: when is true, then function is traced

findings.explanation: Descriptor names/short_desc/extra_desc were read for all 480. Actual settings were deliberately retrieved only for 39 explicitly nonsecret safe entries. No file paths, connection strings, cryptographic keys, external secrets, user data or raw logs retrieved.

fsync=on, full_page_writes=on, zero_damaged_pages=off, ignore_checksum_failure=off, ignore_invalid_pages=off. These safeguards apply to this inspected SQL session; managed-host failover/backup runtime is outside this probe.

password_encryption=scram-sha-256, row_security=on, SSL=on, ssl_min_protocol_version=TLSv1.2 and lo_compat_privileges=off. Does not prove Auth password leak protection, actual REST exposed schemas, JWT audience/issuer or client authorization.

log_parameter_max_length=-1 is uncapped if parameter logging is enabled, but pgaudit.log_parameter=off, log_min_duration_statement=-1, log_statement=ddl, and parameter logging on error=0. No logged private parameters read; do not infer secret leakage.

cron.launch_active_jobs=on is a loaded GUC; pg_cron extension absent and cron namespace absent in this database. A GUC flag alone does not mean scheduled jobs run. External Supabase/backup schedules remain separate.

Autovacuum enabled with default threshold 50, scale 0.2; 46 first-party tables have small approximate live/dead tuples and accumulated scans. n_live_tup/n_dead_tup estimates and null last_autovacuum are not proof of bloat defect; changing host config or running VACUUM is outside authorization.

idle_in_transaction_session_timeout=0 and statement_timeout=120000ms on inspected administrative SQL session. No observed long lock waiters in prior drift baseline; hosted pooler/application effective settings remain unverified.
